name: Background Removal
tagline: Cut a photo's background on your device. No upload, no account, no watermark.
description:
Drop a picture or take a still. The subject stays, the background goes — on this device. There is no account, no credit, no watermark and no queue. The picture never leaves this browser.

An unofficial port of IMG.LY's in-browser background-removal library (IS-Net). The same models do the work: a small one (~44 MB) when you want it faster, a medium one (~88 MB, the usual choice), and a large one (~176 MB). The first cut downloads only the model you picked, checks it against a fingerprint baked into this app, and then the model lives on this device. After that it works on a plane.

Paint a new background — checkerboard, a colour, another picture — without cutting again. Hold the result to see the original. Download a transparent PNG, or a JPEG with the colour you picked. Close it and come back: the last picture and the last cut are still here, inside the file.

Be ready for it to think for a few seconds. A device with a graphics chip is faster; the line at the top says which this one is using.
